artist.name: Tapan Raj
artist.bio: Tapan Raj is a Delhi producer and one half of the electronic duo Midival Punditz with Gaurav Raina. He has been part of Delhi's underground electronic scene since 1997, playing across hip hop, house, breakbeats and garage.

press.title: Electric India: Bangin' the drum and bass with the Midival Punditz
